frozen_before: any live call of this experiment
questions: the 123 frozen QASPER test questions (retrieval-eligible; retrieval on this set was examined before; answer-level results for 88 of them are new, 35 were generated in the earlier pilot with configuration A)

configs.A: structure-aware T=256, dense BGE top-4 (reuses 35 exactly-matching pilot answers)
configs.REF: A + MiniLM cross-encoder rerank of the dense top-20 (selected on dev)
configs.D: REF with an LLM-rewritten search query; evaluated only if it advances on the 41 dev questions

fixed.rewriter: openai/gpt-oss-20b, sees only the question (never references or evidence), max_completion_tokens 256

D_dev_rule: D advances only if dev evidence recall at 1,024 tokens improves >= 0.02 over REF, or MRR@10 >= 0.03 with recall not lower by more than 0.02
primary_endpoint: official QASPER answer F1, REF minus A, paired paper-clustered bootstrap (10,000 reps, seed 7)
decision: 'improved' if 95% CI lower bound > 0; 'non-inferior' if lower bound > -0.05; 'degraded' if upper bound < -0.05; otherwise 'inconclusive'
